scheme_name: Jharkhand State Migrant Labourers Survey and Rehabilitation Scheme
other_conditions: The migrant worker must be a resident of Jharkhand
The death or injury must have occurred due to an accident while working outside the state
The incident must be reported to the nearest government office within a specified timeframe
benefits_summary: Provides financial assistance up to ₹1,50,000 for death or permanent disability and up to ₹75,000 for partial disability, plus covers transportation costs for families.
